name: Omega-3 (EPA/DHA)

lead: Omega-3 fatty acids EPA and DHA come from oily fish, fish oil and algae and are taken for cardiovascular and general health. In appearance contexts they are discussed for skin inflammation, dryness, UV tolerance and recovery.
Results for skin are mixed and modest; the strongest evidence for EPA and DHA concerns triglyceride lowering rather than cosmetic outcomes.

paras: EPA and DHA are incorporated into cell membranes and serve as precursors to specialized pro-resolving mediators such as resolvins and protectins, which help turn off inflammation.

Fish oil can cause fishy aftertaste and digestive upset, and high doses may raise bleeding risk or affect heart rhythm in some people. Contaminant and oxidation quality vary by product. Supplements are sold over the counter.
